bem-digital.title: NGO Hub (Bem-Digital)
bem-digital.shortDescription: Comprehensive modular platform in Laravel & MySQL for donation campaigns, inventory control, and donors.
bem-digital.description: Bem-Digital is a complete and modular system developed in Laravel (Blade/Alpine.js/Tailwind) and MySQL for managing donation campaigns, inventory control, and donors. It empowers non-profit organizations to run transparent and real-time operations.
bem-digital.challenges: The project required structuring a complex relational database, utilizing polymorphism and pivot tables for a permission system based on Modules and Rules. Collaborated in an agile team using Git repositories, Clean Architecture, and Conventional Commits.

fleet-manager.title: Fleet Control System (FleetManager)
fleet-manager.shortDescription: Containerized Docker/Sail system for municipal vehicle management, dispatch operations, and drivers.
fleet-manager.period: Public Sector – City Hall of Umuarama
fleet-manager.description: A robust internal system designed for municipal logistics and fleet yard operations. Implements complete CRUD management with soft deletes, real-time departure and return tracking, fuel monitoring, and dynamic filters.
fleet-manager.challenges: Entire environment containerized using Docker and Laravel Sail to achieve absolute environment parity between development and production. Clean interface styled with Tailwind CSS, strict validation, and optimized SQL queries.

investment-manager.title: Investment Management System
investment-manager.shortDescription: Object-Oriented PHP application utilizing MVC architecture and interactive return charts.
investment-manager.description: Object-Oriented PHP application strictly adhering to MVC (Model-View-Controller) architecture. Enables users to register investments, track yield performance, and project future returns through interactive charts.
investment-manager.challenges: Strict separation of concerns between business logic, data persistence, and UI rendering, applying Clean Code principles, class abstraction, and high-precision financial calculations.

hackathon-events-api.title: Events API & Integrated Front-end
hackathon-events-api.shortDescription: Front-end integration in PHP consuming a complete RESTful API built in Node.js.
hackathon-events-api.description: Event management solution built during a coding marathon to handle participant credentials and event schedules, with asynchronous cross-service communication.
hackathon-events-api.challenges: Developed Node.js back-end RESTful endpoints with token authentication and pagination, alongside PHP front-end data consumption with resilient fallback handling.

chopits.title: Chopits | E-commerce
chopits.shortDescription: Functional virtual store clone focused on global state management and dynamic routing.
chopits.description: A robust Front-end application developed to simulate the shopping experience of a large e-commerce platform, with an interactive shopping cart, product filtering, and real-time checkout calculations.
chopits.challenges: Ensuring strict TypeScript typing across the whole data pipeline, preventing runtime bugs and crafting an ultra-smooth React interface.

tech-store.title: Corporate Website | TechStore
tech-store.shortDescription: Freelance project delivered to a computer hardware store with a modern, responsive design.
tech-store.description: Complete corporate website with multiple pages (Home, Services, About, Contact) designed to attract local clients and highlight maintenance and hardware retail services.
tech-store.challenges: Handled end-to-end execution: client requirement discovery, information architecture, responsive UI design, and mobile performance optimization.
